translationRepairs: 季父房夷離菫剌葛 names 剌葛 (Làgé); idiomatic “Gige” is a mistransliteration, and Lage matches the characters and the unit’s own pinyin.
Literal likewise misrenders 剌葛 as Gige; Chancellor Lage restores the correct personal-name romanization.
奚蹇 is one personal name; spaced “Xi Jian” falsely implies a Chinese surname–given split, and Xijian is the correct single-name rendering.
Literal likewise splits 奚蹇 into “Xi Jian”; Xijian restores the undivided personal name.
Bei, the Emperor who Ceded the State and was Literary Contributor.
Bei, the Wenxian Emperor who Ceded the State.

讓國文獻皇帝倍 treats 文獻 as the posthumous name Wenxian, so “was Literary Contributor” is wrong; the proposal’s full pinyin Rangguo Wenxian drops the chapter’s translated 讓國 phrasing—“Wenxian Emperor who Ceded the State” keeps that wording while fixing 文獻.
Right descent line from Emperor Xingzong the Divine Sage, Great Filial and Patterned.
Right descent line from Emperor Xingzong the Divine Sage, Filial and Patterned.
興宗神聖孝章皇帝 has 孝 with no 大; idiomatic “Great Filial” invents an epithet absent from the Chinese.
Right descent line from Emperor Xingzong the Divine Sage, Great Filial and Patterned.
Right descent line from Emperor Xingzong the Divine Sage, Filial and Patterned.
Literal likewise invents “Great” before Filial; 神聖孝章皇帝 supports only Divine Sage, Filial and Patterned.
